abilities.name: Psionic Presence
abilities.text: All Weapons of Friendly Units targeting an Enemy Unit Within 4″ of this Unit's Shade token gain PRECISION (1).

abilities.name: Psionic Transfer
abilities.text: Set a Shade token Wholly Within 12″ of any model in this Unit. At the End of the Round, the controlling player may set all models of this Unit in Coherency, treating the Shade token as the Leading Model. The Shade token has DISPLACEMENT.

upgrades.name: Guidance
upgrades.text: This Unit's Glaive Cannon Ranged weapon gains ANTI-EVADE (2).

upgrades.name: Resonating Glaives
upgrades.text: This Unit's Glaive Cannon gains BUFF RoA (1).
